name: Dimension of Monster Girls
source:
Morgan's life is going nowhere and he hates it. He's stuck at a low paying job after he dropped out of college. He survives by eating only cheap food in a tiny apartment. 

When a ship that he's on to visit his parents sinks, he's unable to get to the lifeboats in time. Just before he runs out of air, he sees a light and finds himself in a strange world ruled by monster girls. In this world he encounters three of them, one after the other. 

Each of them want him to be their husband because there are only females of their species, so monster girls only have humans to choose from if they desire children. Due to how their world works, there is a very short time limit on Morgan's choice. The three girls decide to have one day with him each and one shared day with all of them. Afterwards, he will decide who he likes best.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/812410/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
摩根的生活毫无进展，他讨厌这样。大学退学后，他一直从事一份低薪工作。他在一间小公寓里只吃廉价食物生存。

当他去探望父母的一艘船沉没时，他无法及时到达救生艇。就在他耗尽空气之前，他看到了一道光，发现自己身处一个由怪物女孩统治的奇怪世界。在这个世界上，他一前一后地遇到了三个人。

她们每个人都希望他成为她们的丈夫，因为她们的物种只有雌性，所以怪物女孩如果想要孩子的话只能选择人类。由于他们的世界是如何运转的，摩根的选择的时间限制非常短。三个女孩决定分别与他共度一天，并与她们所有人共享一天。之后，他会决定他最喜欢谁。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/812410/]Steam[/url]]
